Image 1 is the painting style reference only; do not copy its scenery.
Image 2 is the character design of CHENG ZHEN (their daughter, keep her face and eyes); in this picture CHENG ZHEN is about 17 years old.
Image 3 is the character design of THE SENIOR GIRL (keep her face, short boyish hair and freckles); in this picture THE SENIOR GIRL is about 18 years old.
Image 4 is the character design of LIN XIANGWAN (the woman, keep her face, eyes and fine wispy bangs; long straight black hair); in this picture LIN XIANGWAN is about 45 years old.

Scene: the small entrance hall of a Taiwanese apartment: a front door, a low wooden shoe cabinet, a row of key hooks on the wall, a narrow tiled floor where shoes are left, the front door just opened, evening light.
CHENG ZHEN (17) stands inside, very nervous. Behind her THE SENIOR GIRL bows stiffly, holding a box of fruit. LIN XIANGWAN (45) has
just stepped forward and is holding out a pair of guest slippers toward the girl with both hands, a warm natural smile.

Painting style: delicate transparent watercolor on textured cold-press paper, exactly like image 1: pale luminous washes, soft natural light, loose soft wet edges, visible paper grain, unpainted white paper areas. Hand-painted watercolor illustration, not anime cel shading, not 3D, not photo.
Wide 16:9 landscape composition. Keep all important subjects and faces in the upper two thirds of the frame; the bottom third should be calm, low-detail ground or background (a text box will cover it). People do not look at the viewer unless stated. Correct anatomy: each hand has exactly five fingers, left and right hands on the correct sides; any hand not described is hidden out of view. Modern everyday objects look plain and timeless, nothing futuristic. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no signage, no watermark.
